name: claude-code-mods

plugins.name: copy-code
plugins.description: Adds a small copy link under every code block Claude writes, copying the code exactly as written

plugins.name: copy-session-id
plugins.description: /sid copies the current session ID to the clipboard

plugins.name: focus-notes
plugins.description: Shows the text Claude writes between tool calls in a band above the prompt, so focus mode never hides it

plugins.name: keep-warm
plugins.description: /keep-warm: ping the session's prompt cache 55 minutes after the last request so it stays warm

plugins.name: cache-countdown
plugins.description: Counts down to prompt-cache expiry in the status line, restarting with each main-thread model request

description: Small Claude Code mods: copy code blocks and the session ID, show notes focus mode hides, and keep an eye on the prompt cache.
